annotations.title: Website audit, security audit: uptime, SEO, security headers, redirects and DNS

description: One call to audit a website: is it up and how fast, the redirect chain (including whether plain http moves to https), the on-page SEO audit with its score and issues, HTTP security headers and their grade, robots.txt for the page, and the domain's DNS, email authentication and registration age. Server-side HTML only, no JavaScript. Cheaper than the six tools bought one by one. Use before a launch, for a client report or to compare competitors. Example: url=https://www.wikipedia.org/. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
